title: Vanity's Sin
description: Enter a dimension on a god's skin...why? Idk you're the one doing it.
body:
Vanity's sin is a mod ive been working on for a while now, its hopped from bedrock to curseforge to modrinth, this version is by far the best(obviously, its the newest one.
Id go into more detail but this is like my 3rd time trying to write this damn description so im sick of writing.
Okay so i have to i guess
Vanity's sin is a mod that will, eventually have you venturing in a dimension made from the living breathing flesh of the god of lust, Vanity, this mod is inspired by the game "ULTRAKILL" by Hakita "arsi" patala and will focus on dungeon crawling rather than survival (i should clarify that Dungeons, nor crawling have been added in any way, shape or form) really im just publishing this alpha just to put in my own modpacks just for the hell of it, but later releases will be more suited towards normal people.
EVERYTHING IN THIS MOD WAS MADE USING MCREATOR, DO NOT IMPLEMENT INTO A LONGTERM MODPACK UNLESS YOU **REALLY** LIKE THIS MOD FOR SOME REASON, TRUST ME, ITS HAPPENED TO ME BEFORE.

![Vanity Nexus Crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f33c93cf71ba5a317507b8519d88310cd2dd8eca.png)

green and black squares represent blocks with no textures, so in the final release those should all be gone, unless its funnier if i dont i guess.
The Vanity Nexus's crafting recipe will be removed when i figure out how to make a structure act remotely like a stronghold

Adds, a wood type, hemolyte block set, blood, alot of blood, like an iron lung amount of blood, do you get what im saying, i added an ocean of blood, marcasite armor and tool set, a whole new dimension with 2 (albiet, barren) biomes, 3 new ores, hemolyte iron ore, vermillion yet again, a structure(unfinished) and a lot more!
